title: "The Chess Game Begins"
next_chapter_hook: "Su Qingyao's voice echoed in the darkness, Chen Ji's knuckles turned white as he clenched his fists — so from start to finish, he had only ever been a discarded piece on someone's chessboard."

text.content: "Before Su Qingyao could finish speaking, Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest — it was the warning from the Tianji Record Fragment, as if some nameless existence was piercing through layers of mist, watching him. That gaze was cold and lofty, like a deity looking down at ants, causing every hair on his body to stand on end. He suppressed the shock in his heart, his expression unchanged as usual, yet in the depths of his pupils, a cold gleam flickered past — one he himself had not even noticed."

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao pushed a scroll of yellowed bamboo slips in front of him, her voice extremely low: 'This is what I discovered last night in the Forbidden Grounds of the Scripture Library. Three hundred years ago, there was an elder of the Tianqing Sect who had also obtained a similar fragment — his name was Chen Xuan.' Her gaze locked onto Chen Ji's face, 'Was your father also named Chen?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's heart sank violently. Chen Xuan — that was a name he had seen in the Tianji Record Fragment, the bizarre existence described by Mo Xiansheng as 'chosen yet not chosen.' He reached out for the bamboo slips, and the moment his fingertips touched the bamboo strips, a familiar warmth surged through him, as if something was awakening in his bloodline. The slips were densely covered with ancient runes, and at the very bottom, four characters were clearly written — 'Heavenly Fate Chess Game.'"

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao's voice trembled slightly: 'Three hundred years ago, Chen Xuan was the destined successor of the Sect Master, yet he died on the night the Tianji Record chose its master. His death was identical to the recorded 'Heavenly Fate Rebound.' And thirty years ago, your father, Chen Yuanshan —' she paused, 'He left a secret letter before his death, and the recipient's name was precisely the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's fingers tightened around the bamboo slips, his knuckles white. The scene of his father's death surged over him like a tide — that rainy night, his father bathed in blood, using his last strength to write a 'flee' character on his palm. He had always thought it was his father's helplessness at death's door, the shame of a useless father who couldn't protect him. But now, an even more terrifying thought arose: could his father's death have never been an accident at all?"

"He drew a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions, and looked up at Su Qingyao: 'Is that all you found in the Forbidden Grounds of the Scripture Library?' Su Qingyao shook her head and drew another Jade Slip from her sleeve: 'There's also this — it records the true conditions for the Tianji Record's master selection.' She handed him the slip, 'It's not bone quality, not comprehension, but 'destined fate.' Chen Ji, do you know what your own fate is?'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji infused spiritual energy into the Jade Slip, and a line of ancient text appeared before his eyes — 'Heavenly Fate chess pieces may peer into heavenly secrets without mastering them, may be pieces without knowing it. Those born of this fate must be from the Chen bloodline, lose their father in youth, lose their mother in youth, have a difficult fate yet never die, conceal themselves with 'worthlessness,' nurture fortune with 'suffering.'' His pupils contracted sharply, as if all the blood in his body had frozen in an instant. This passage was clearly describing his entire twenty years of life!"

choice.prompt: "Faced with this truth that could overturn all understanding, Chen Ji needed to make a choice:"

choices.text: "Enter the Game — Actively Seek the Truth"
choices.description: "Since the chess game has already formed, take the initiative to strike, find flaws in the mastermind behind the scenes, rather than waiting passively for death."
choices.visible_cost: "Exposure risk greatly increases, may引来更大危机"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain more clues about the Tianji Record and his father"
choices.risk_hint: "Once exposed, will become the target of all"

text.content: "Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh — that laugh was low and cold, like a demon crawling out of hell. Su Qingyao's heart shuddered at the sight; at this moment, she finally believed this 'waste' was no ordinary person. Chen Ji tucked the bamboo slips into his sleeve, his eyes flickering with brilliance: 'So be it, I'll enter the game. Since someone wants to watch a show, I'll flip this entire chessboard.'"

choices.description: "Rather than passively investigating, better to first understand the chess game's rules, seek methods to defeat the strong with the weak."
choices.visible_cost: "Requires more time to strategize, may miss key information"
choices.visible_reward: "Remain low-profile, lower exposure risk, gain more guidance from Mo Xiansheng"
choices.risk_hint: "The truth may be buried even deeper"

text.content: "Chen Ji gently set down the Jade Slip, a playful curve forming at the corner of his mouth: 'Enter the game? No, before I understand the rules, I'll only continue being my waste.' His voice was terrifyingly calm, 'Su Senior Sister, what happened today, you never discovered, and I never knew.' Su Qingyao stared at him blankly; at this moment, she suddenly understood something — this man's scheming was far deeper than she had imagined."

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao lowered her voice, her gaze burning: 'There's one more thing. Old Sect Master Ling Yuan's birthday is approaching, and disciples from all three major sects will attend. I found out that the original of your father's secret letter is hidden in Ling Yuan's secret chamber.' She paused, 'Moreover, I discovered a strange phenomenon — the last time the Tianji Record Fragment showed abnormal activity, it was exactly the day your father died.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. The Tianji Record's abnormality, his father's death, Ling Yuan's secret letter — these three clues intertwined in his mind like three vipers. He suddenly recalled something Mo Xiansheng had once said: 'Those chosen by the Tianji Record are never just one. But the one who ultimately survives is always only one.' Could both his father and himself be pieces in this chess game? Then, who is the true chess player?"

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji needed to make a choice between two paths:"

choices.text: "Go Into the Tiger's Den, Investigate the Secret Letter"
choices.description: "Take advantage of Ling Yuan's birthday to infiltrate the secret chamber, see firsthand what his father left behind."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain crucial evidence, completely uncover the truth of his father's death"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan is a hidden BOSS, his strength is unfathomable"

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao gazed at him deeply, a complex light flickering in her eyes: 'You're insane.' But then, she drew a token from her sleeve, 'However, I will help you. This is the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's passage token; on the birthday, the secret chamber guard will be reduced by thirty percent.' Her voice trembled almost imperceptibly, 'Chen Ji, I don't want to see you die.'"

choices.description: "Continue playing the role of a waste, use the Tianji Record's ability to preview the variables on the birthday, seek a more stable opportunity."
choices.visible_cost: "Consumes Heavenly Fate, may miss the timing"
choices.visible_reward: "Master more information, greater certainty of escaping unharmed"

dialogue.content: "A flash of disappointment crossed Su Qingyao's eyes, but was soon replaced by understanding: 'You're right, you've never been a impulsive person.' She tucked the token back into her sleeve, 'Then I'll go gather more intelligence. There are still seven days until the birthday; if you change your mind, come find me anytime.' As she turned to leave, her footsteps paused, 'Chen Ji, be careful of Ling Yuan. He's more terrifying than you can imagine.'"

text.content: "After Su Qingyao left, Chen Ji stood alone, the night wind stirring his robes, bringing a desolate chill. He slowly raised his hand, pressing it against his chest — the Tianji Record Fragment's temperature was gradually cooling, yet that feeling of being watched coiled around him like a venomous snake. He closed his eyes, and a thought flashed through his mind: if his father's death, his own suffering, even the inheritance of the Tianji Record, were all pieces in a chess game... then what does the chess player actually want?"

dialogue.content: "Just then, an aged and ethereal voice rang in his mind — it was Mo Xiansheng's voice: 'Master, you have finally begun to touch the truth.' Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, alarm bells ringing in his heart: 'What do you know?' Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted over, carrying an indescribable compassion: 'This old servant knows much, but Master's current realm is not yet sufficient to bear those truths.' After a pause, his voice suddenly became extraordinarily grave, 'Master, have you ever considered... that the Tianji Record itself is also a piece placed by someone else?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji froze. The Tianji Record... is also a piece? He looked down at the faintly glowing mark on his chest, a bone-deep chill rising from the soles of his feet to his crown. If even the Tianji Record is a piece, then how vast is the chessboard of this game? What is the chess player's purpose? He suddenly recalled what Su Qingyao had just said — Chen Xuan from three hundred years ago died from 'Heavenly Fate Rebound.' And his father had died mysteriously as well. The connection between these two people was not merely the Tianji Record's inheritance, but something far deeper."

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time with unprecedented solemnity: 'Master, this old servant can only tell you one thing — before your father died, he left this old servant with a phrase.' Chen Ji's fists clenched violently: 'What words?' Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, as if weighing whether he should speak; ultimately, his voice was low and distant: 'He said — 'The Eye of Heaven's Way never closes. Its gaze is the very meaning of our existence.'"

text.content: "The Eye of Heaven's Way. Chen Ji repeated these four characters, feeling as if all the blood in his body was boiling. The Eye of Heaven's Way — wasn't that said to be Heaven's Will itself? How could it play chess against people? How could it scheme across the world? But if all this were true... then his twenty years of endurance, disguise, and struggle were merely self-comforting antics of an ant in the eyes of such an existence. An unprecedented rage and defiance surged in Chen Ji's chest. Chen Ji would never be anyone's piece!"

choice.prompt: "Faced with this truth that could overturn three worlds, Chen Ji's heart was struggling intensely:"

choices.text: "Defy Heaven and Change Fate, Break Through the Game"
choices.description: "Since Heaven wants to play, then he'll play along to the end — with a mortal body, shake the gods."
choices.visible_reward: "Awaken the true complete form of the Tianji Record, gain power to oppose the Eye of Heaven's Way"
choices.risk_hint: "The Eye of Heaven's Way's gaze will intensify"

text.content: "Chen Ji laughed toward the heavens, that laughter echoing through the silent night, carrying a hint of madness, a resolve to the death: 'Good, very good! If Heaven wants to play with me, then Chen Ji will play with it to the end!' His eyes blazed with unprecedented light, the mark on his chest vibrated violently, as if responding to his will. Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled slightly: 'Master... you intend to challenge Heaven with a mortal body?' Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, black hair wildly dancing in the wind: 'Exactly. If Heaven destroys me, I shall defy Heaven!'"

choices.text: "Hide One's Brilliance, Bide Time for a Slow Plan"
choices.description: "Before absolute power, lowering one's head is no disgrace. Survive, to win the future."
choices.visible_cost: "Must continue enduring the title of waste, inner torment"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain mystery, let enemies continue to underestimate, wait for the opportunity to strike with certainty"

text.content:
"Chen Ji收起眼中的光芒，面容重归平静，仿佛刚才的癫狂只是一场幻觉。他低声呢喃：'棋局已成，执棋者现……但谁是棋子，谁是棋手，还未可知。'他转身望向天青宗的方向，眼中闪过一丝冷厉，'凌渊，寿辰见。既然你们想看戏，我就给你们演一场大戏——只不过，结局如何，可由不得你们。'

"Chen Ji tucked away the light in his eyes, his features regaining their calm, as if the earlier madness had merely been an illusion. He murmured softly: 'The chess game has formed, the chess player has appeared... but who is the piece, who is the player, remains to be seen.' He turned to gaze toward Tianqing Sect, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes, 'Ling Yuan, see you at the birthday celebration. Since you all want to watch a show, I'll perform a grand play for you — however, how it ends, that is not up to you.'"

"The night wind suddenly stopped, and the surrounding insect chirps fell eerily silent. Chen Ji felt an intangible pressure descend from above, that sensation of being watched appearing once more, stronger and clearer than ever before. He猛地抬头，望向夜空深处——在那漆黑的苍穹之上，仿佛有一只巨大的眼睛，正穿透层层虚空，直直地注视着他。那目光冰冷、无情、高高在上，带着审视蝼蚁的淡漠。陈机与那只不存在的眼睛对视，心中涌起一个可怕的念头：它知道了。它知道他已经察觉了棋局的存在。

"The night wind suddenly ceased, and the surrounding insects' chirping eerily fell silent. Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure descend from above, that sensation of being watched appearing once more, stronger and clearer than any time before. He sharply raised his head, gazing into the depths of the night sky — in that pitch-black heavens above, it was as if a colossal eye was piercing through layers of void, staring directly at him. That gaze was cold, merciless, lofty, carrying the indifference of one examining ants. Chen Ji stared into that non-existent eye, a terrifying thought surging in his heart: it knew. It knew he had already sensed the existence of the chess game."

dialogue.content:
"就在此时，一个声音忽然在陈机脑海中炸响——那声音不是墨先生的苍老，不是苏青瑶的清冷，而是一种难以形容的、仿佛来自九天之上的威压：'蝼蚁之身，也敢窥探天机？'陈机浑身剧震，一口鲜血险些喷出。他的脑海中，天机录残页剧烈颤抖，仿佛在瑟瑟发抖。那道声音继续响起，带着一丝玩味：'有趣……三百年前的陈玄如此，三十年前的陈远山如此，今日的你，亦如此。'顿了顿，声音变得冰冷刺骨，'记住——棋子，永远只能是棋子。'

"Just then, a voice suddenly exploded in Chen Ji's mind — that voice was not Mo Xiansheng's aged tone, not Su Qingyao's cold clarity, but an indescribable pressure as if emanating from the Nine Heavens: 'A mere ant dares to peer into heavenly secrets?' Chen Ji shuddered violently, nearly spitting out a mouthful of blood. In his mind, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled intensely, as if cowering in fear. The voice continued, carrying a hint of amusement: 'Interesting... Chen Xuan three hundred years ago was like this, Chen Yuanshan thirty years ago was like this, and today, you are the same.' After a pause, the voice turned ice-cold and biting, 'Remember — a piece will always and only be a piece.'"

text.content:
"声音消散，陈机单膝跪地，冷汗浸透了后背。他大口喘息着，眼中却燃起了比之前更加炽烈的光芒——那是被蔑视后的愤怒，是被羞辱后的疯狂，更是不甘做棋子的铮铮铁骨。他缓缓站起身，抬手抹去嘴角的血迹，对着虚空咧嘴一笑：'天道之眼……我记住你了。'他的声音低沉而危险，'总有一天，我会让你知道，蝼蚁之怒，亦可倾天。'陈机转身离去，背影在月光下拉得很长。这一夜，他从一个浑浑噩噩的废物，彻底蜕变成了一个心怀天道的复仇者。

"The voice faded away, and Chen Ji knelt on one knee, cold sweat soaking through his back. He gasped heavily, yet in his eyes burned a light more intense than ever before — that was the fury of being despised, the madness of being humiliated, and most of all, the iron will refusing to be a piece. He slowly stood up, wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, and grinned at the void: 'Eye of Heaven's Way... I remember you.' His voice was low and dangerous, 'Someday, I will make you understand — an ant's rage can also topple the heavens.' Chen Ji turned and walked away, his silhouette stretching long under the moonlight. This night, he had completely transformed from a muddle-headed waste into a Heaven-defying avenger."
